title: Glessner's east wing roof is whole again over the court
items: A strip of the east wing's court-side roof, from the eave to the ridge beside the middle chimney, was missing: the cut made for the low copper roof in the court corner ran on past its end. The tiles there are back.
In the 3D-print export, the vines' thin stems now go with their leaves, so the stone between the Prairie Avenue windows prints clean instead of dotted.
